Transform the ocean_background_sunken_route into a perfectly seamless tileable texture that repeats in both horizontal and vertical directions. Heal all visible seams, brightness bands, and hard joins to create a uniform blue-teal ocean water pattern with luminous caustics. Remove all vignettes, gradients, and borders to ensure perfectly uniform average brightness across the entire image. No fish, plants, or objects. Match the exact texture scale and top-down aquatic style of the original.

Resize the image of the dark hammered iron narwhal with glowing cyan runes from image 1. Keep the top-down perspective, transparent background, and all visual details identical. The output should be a high-resolution, professional quality game asset with the same artistic style, colors, and lighting as the original, just adjusted to a standard 768px scale.
A massive, mysterious deep-sea Kraken silhouette with a single glowing eye and curled tentacles, viewed from above.

A small orange-and-white striped clownfish for environmental schooling effects, top-down view.
A resized, high-resolution Tier 20 armored warrior narwhal with a compact vertical silhouette.
A seamless, top-down light turquoise tropical water background with subtle, dense caustic patterns.

Enhance the sunken wooden galleon from image 1 to be more visually striking. Increase wood grain detail and contrast. Add subtle golden-amber highlights on the hull edges. Make the barnacles and coral growths more colorful with warm oranges and soft greens. Increase overall color saturation and sharpness so the asset stands out against a blue-teal ocean background. Maintain the top-down perspective, general composition, and transparent background. Detailed, high-resolution game asset.

Keep the exact visual appearance, colors, and sandy-tan mottled texture of the narwhal in image 1. Maintain the top-down perspective and beady eyes. Only resize the image to a high-resolution 768-pixel version without altering any artistic details or transparency. Transparent background.
A very soft, subliminal underwater bubble micro-pop for frequent orb collection.

Recolor the existing `collectible_plankton` asset. Change the color palette from lime green to a warm golden-yellow, using rich gold and amber midtones with bright yellow highlights. Maintain the exact cluster shape, glossy bubbles, sparkle details, and proportions of the original image. The result should look like a valuable gold/amber pickup while keeping the silhouette and transparent background identical to the input.

A seamless looping background track for a friendly ocean-themed .io game. Bright, inviting, and playful aquatic adventure vibe at 105 BPM. Features soft marimba and mallet melodies, light rounded percussion with brushed snares, and warm electric bass. Atmospheric airy synth pads and very subtle watery textures in the background. Restrained and breathable melody that avoids listener fatigue. No vocals, no cinematic builds, no aggressive drums, and no sharp metallic pings. The track must be perfectly loopable with a natural musical transition from end to beginning. Mixed for background play with frequency space for sound effects.

Create a minimal, extremely soft underwater 'blup' sound effect. The sound should be a gentle, muffled bubble pop with a warm, rounded low-mid frequency character and absolutely no sharp high-end or bright chimes. It must have a smooth attack with no transient click or spike, and an instant natural cutoff. Designed for high-frequency repetition in a casual aquatic game, it should be barely perceptible and non-fatiguing. Short duration, one-shot, dry with no reverb tail.
A violet-purple predatory deep-sea anglerfish with a vivid neon purple lure, top-down view.
A Tier 17 Magma Narwhal evolution with glowing molten veins, resized for technical consistency while preserving all visual details.

Change the shark from image 1 to have its mouth WIDE OPEN in a terrifying, aggressive attack pose. The gaping maw should reveal rows of sharp triangular teeth. Keep the top-down perspective and the shark facing RIGHT. The body shape and proportions must remain identical to image 1 for seamless animation. Change the lateral line bioluminescence to a bright red/orange glow and add a red tint to the eyes to signal danger. High-quality, semi-realistic ocean game aesthetic, transparent background, top-down view.

Short premium underwater boost sound effect. A sharp pressurized water jet burst, similar to a powerful dolphin kick through water. Features a tight, snappy whoosh with a distinct watery texture and a quick high-pressure release. Energetic and satisfying feedback with no long tail and no metallic resonance. Designed for frequent use in a marine environment.

Keep the exact visual appearance, colors, and details of the stone narwhal in narwhal_tier_08_v2. A top-down view of a fantasy narwhal with warm orange and terracotta rock textures. Maintain the transparent background and identical artistic style, but output at a higher resolution with the longest side at 768 pixels.

Maintain the exact visual identity, colors, and jade plating of the narwhal in narwhal_tier_06_v2. A deep sea-green narwhal with a translucent jade tusk, top-down view. High-resolution game asset on a transparent background, ensuring the longest side is 768 pixels while preserving the original art style and character design perfectly.
An enhanced, high-contrast sunken galleon with vibrant coral and golden highlights, viewed from above.
A more vibrant and intensely glowing version of the bioluminescent deep-sea coral for better visibility.
Atmospheric and rhythmic deep-sea background music for exploration levels, blending melodic synths with aquatic textures.

Update the existing ocean_background_coral_gardens to be a perfectly seamless 1024x1024 texture. Preserve the current turquoise palette, brightness, caustic scale, and low-contrast top-down water appearance. Ensure the left edge matches the right and the top edge matches the bottom with zero visible seams or hard joins. Remove any brightness gradients, dark bands, or vignette effects. No fish, plants, rocks, or UI elements. The final result must be a clean, infinite water surface texture that tiles in both directions.

Generate a high-resolution, top-down view of a narwhal character exactly matching the design in image 01M014XQ1765WG2MJ8Y6NVKAHB.
